files.content:
name: Test V2 runner
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Fetch pinned rubric baseline
        run: git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin 421390ea7fa4708f3d89d7695f9a16debb861daf
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
      - run: uv sync --frozen --python 3.12
      - run: uv run python review_rubric_revision.py
      - run: BCODE_TEST_CHROME="$(command -v google-chrome)" uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests
      - run: uv run ruff check bcode_runner.py bcode_eval.py bcode_results.py tests/test_bcode_runner.py tests/test_bcode_binary.py
      - run: go install github.com/rhysd/actionlint/cmd/actionlint@v1.7.7
      - run: |
          "$(go env GOPATH)/bin/actionlint" .github/workflows/run-benchmark.yml

name: Run Benchmark Batch

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      model:
        description: 'Model to evaluate (see run_batch.py MODELS dict)'
        required: true
        type: string
      start:
        description: 'Start task index (inclusive)'
        required: true
        type: number
      end:
        description: 'End task index (exclusive)'
        required: true
        type: number
      parallel:
        description: 'Max concurrent tasks'
        required: false
        default: '3'
        type: string
      tracking_id:
        description: 'UUID for orchestrator to match results'
        required: true
        type: string
      run_start:
        description: 'Run start timestamp for aggregation'
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  run-batch:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v4
        with:
          version: "latest"

      - name: Set up Python
        run: uv python install 3.12

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync

      - name: Run benchmark batch
        env:
          BROWSER_USE_SETUP_LOGGING: "false"
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
          BROWSER_USE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.BROWSER_USE_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          uv run python run_batch.py \
            --model "${{ inputs.model }}" \
            --start ${{ inputs.start }} \
            --end ${{ inputs.end }} \
            --parallel ${{ inputs.parallel }} \
            --tracking-id "${{ inputs.tracking_id }}" \
            --run-start "${{ inputs.run_start }}" \
            --output result.json

      - name: Upload result
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: batch-${{ inputs.tracking_id }}
          path: result.json
          retention-days: 30

name: Run BU Bench V2
run-name: BU200 ${{ inputs.browser }} · ${{ inputs.model }} · ${{ inputs.tasks }} tasks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      browser:
        description: Browser provider
        type: choice
        options: [browser-use-cloud, local_headless]
        default: browser-use-cloud
      model:
        description: BrowserCode provider/model
        type: string
        default: openai/gpt-6-luna
      reasoning:
        description: Agent reasoning effort
        type: choice
        options: [none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max]
        default: xhigh
      tasks:
        description: Number of tasks (all 200 by default)
        type: number
        default: 200
      task_ids:
        description: Optional exact task IDs separated by spaces
        type: string
      task_timeout:
        description: Seconds per task
        type: number
        default: 3600
      max_parallel:
        description: Maximum concurrent task runners
        type: number
        default: 100
      fetch_use:
        description: Enable BrowserCode fetch service (requires Browser Use key)
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  BROWSER_USE_SETUP_LOGGING: "false"

jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      task_ids: ${{ steps.tasks.outputs.task_ids }}
      evaluation_id: ${{ steps.tasks.outputs.evaluation_id }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
      - run: uv sync --frozen --python 3.12 --extra laminar
      - name: Validate inputs and select tasks
        id: tasks
        env:
          TASK_IDS: ${{ inputs.task_ids }}
          TASK_COUNT: ${{ inputs.tasks }}
          MAX_PARALLEL: ${{ inputs.max_parallel }}
          TASK_TIMEOUT: ${{ inputs.task_timeout }}
          EVAL_MODEL: ${{ inputs.model }}
          EVAL_BROWSER: ${{ inputs.browser }}
          LMNR_PROJECT_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.LMNR_PROJECT_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import os
          assert 1 <= int(os.environ["MAX_PARALLEL"]) <= 200
          assert 1 <= int(os.environ["TASK_TIMEOUT"]) <= 14400
          PY
          uv run python bcode_results.py prepare --tasks "$TASK_COUNT" --task-ids "$TASK_IDS"

  evaluate:
    needs: prepare
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: ${{ fromJSON(format('{0}', inputs.max_parallel)) }}
      matrix:
        task_id: ${{ fromJSON(needs.prepare.outputs.task_ids) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 260
    env:
      BROWSER_USE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.BROWSER_USE_API_KEY }}
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY }}
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      XAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.XAI_API_KEY }}
      LMNR_PROJECT_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.LMNR_PROJECT_API_KEY }}
      BENCHMARK_LAMINAR_EVAL_ID: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.evaluation_id }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
      - run: uv sync --frozen --python 3.12 --extra laminar
      - name: Install BrowserCode
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bcode.sh/install | bash -s -- --version 0.1.20 --no-modify-path
      - name: Execute and judge task
        env:
          TASK_ID: ${{ matrix.task_id }}
          EVAL_MODEL: ${{ inputs.model }}
          REASONING: ${{ inputs.reasoning }}
          BROWSER: ${{ inputs.browser }}
          TASK_TIMEOUT: ${{ inputs.task_timeout }}
          FETCH_USE: ${{ inputs.fetch_use }}
        run: |
          fetch_flag=--no-fetch-use
          if [ "$FETCH_USE" = true ]; then fetch_flag=--fetch-use; fi
          uv run python run_eval.py \
            --task-ids "$TASK_ID" --parallel 1 \
            --model "$EVAL_MODEL" --agent-reasoning "$REASONING" \
            --browser "$BROWSER" "$fetch_flag" \
            --task-timeout "$TASK_TIMEOUT" --output-dir run_data
      - name: Export public-safe configuration
        if: ${{ always() }}
        run: uv run python bcode_results.py export
      - name: Upload scores and configuration
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: score-${{ matrix.task_id }}
          path: |
            run_data/**/public-result.json
            run_data/**/public-config.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Retain full evidence in private repositories
        if: ${{ always() && github.event.repository.private }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: evidence-${{ matrix.task_id }}
          path: |
            run_data
            !run_data/**/browser-profile/**
            !run_data/**/state/**
            !run_data/**/preflight-state/**
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

  aggregate:
    if: ${{ always() && needs.prepare.result == 'success' }}
    needs: [prepare, evaluate]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
      - run: uv sync --frozen --python 3.12
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: score-*
          path: artifacts
      - name: Check every task and aggregate scores
        env:
          EXPECTED_TASK_IDS: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.task_ids }}
        run: uv run python bcode_results.py aggregate --root artifacts
      - name: Upload aggregate results
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bu-bench-v2-aggregate
          path: aggregate-results.json
          retention-days: 30

[project]
name = "browser-use-benchmark"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Open source benchmark for browser-use"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = [
    "browser-use==0.11.5",
    "certifi",
    "cryptography",
    "httpx",
    "openpyxl>=3.1.5,<4",
    "pillow>=12.1.0",
    "python-dotenv",
    "websockets>=15,<17",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
laminar = ["lmnr==0.7.56"]

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[dependency-groups]
dev = ["ruff>=0.12,<1"]
plots = ["matplotlib", "numpy"]

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["."]
